description: Fork of exp653 (no residual_lut, tracking ~20mb behind exp650). Redistribute the 9.44M param budget saved by removing residual_lut into out_proj LUTs: tph 256 -> 320 (+25%), adds 1,572,864/layer * 6 = 9,437,184 — exactly matches the budget freed. Per layer: out_proj weights 256*64*384=6,291,456 -> 320*64*384=7,864,320. Expected total params ~86.51M (matched to exp650 = 1.4825). Tests whether trading residual_lut capacity for larger out_proj at the same param budget pays off. Reference: exp650 = 1.4825 (residual_lut, tph=256), exp653 = ~1.5x (no residual_lut, tph=256, killed early), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
